title: Why natural silicone alternatives are gaining ground in beauty
summary: Natural silicone alternatives offer the beauty industry an opportunity to move the silicones conversation on from ‘free from’ to ‘better with’, writes Andrei Slipchenko, Director of Regulatory and IP Strategy at SMEY
